Starling is a standalone arcade salvage game: fly through three sectors, bank
cargo, chain pickups, and choose ship upgrades between sectors.

### Download and play

1. Download the **Starling-…-macOS-universal.zip** asset below.
2. Unzip it and open **Starling.app**. Godot is not required.
3. Press **Enter** to launch. Move with **WASD / arrows**, dash with **Space**,
   pulse with **E**, and pause with **Esc / P**.

The universal app supports Apple Silicon (macOS 13+) and Intel (macOS 11+).
This build is ad-hoc signed and **not Apple-notarized**, so downloaded copies may
require approval through macOS Privacy & Security before opening.

### Verification

CI runs the expedition integration suite, exports a release build, checks both
CPU architectures and the app signature, and launches the app from an extracted
copy of the final ZIP. `SHA256SUMS.txt` contains the download's SHA-256 checksum.
